<p>“Huuu… Calm down.”</p><p>After taking a few deep breaths, I picked up my phone again.</p><p>I read the title of the most upvoted article that came up when I searched my name.</p><p>「Instead of the Debate Stage, to the Gate… Trust Born from Silence, Vice President Candidate Yoon Seong-hyeon」</p><p>It’s too early to be disappointed.</p><p>Online articles often use sensational headlines just to get clicks.</p><p>For all I know, the actual content might criticize me.</p><p>My fingers trembled as I clicked on the article.</p><p>As the public debate for the Hunter Association’s vice president election was marred by heated arguments and emotional clashes among some candidates, the absence of Yoon Seong-hyeon—who instead entered the Daejeon A-rank Gate alone and completed the exploration—has unexpectedly drawn attention.</p><p>An Association official stated, “His absence from the debate was a pre-scheduled matter,” and added, “Candidate Yoon Seong-hyeon has consistently maintained the stance that ‘action speaks louder than words.’”</p><p>Among citizens, reactions such as</p><p>“We need Hunters who actually clear Gates, not those who just argue at a desk,”</p><p>and “The vice president should be a Hunter, not a politician,”</p><p>have been pouring in.</p><p>“Ah.”</p><p>「The Debate Was a Battlefield, One Candidate Was at the Gate」</p><p>「The Hunter Who Talks vs. The Hunter Who Hunts」</p><p>「〈From Debate to Battlefield〉… Vice President Candidate Clears Gates Alone」</p><p>As expected from a profession that earns its bread through writing, there was no end to the clickbait headlines I couldn’t resist tapping on.</p><p>At first, my heart pounded so hard I thought it might burst, but soon, an unnatural calm settled over me. I perched on the edge of my bed and called Han Ji-hyeok.</p><p>-Seong-hyeon.</p><p>-Yes, President. Is now a good time to talk?</p><p>-It is.</p><p>-You saw the articles?</p><p>-I did.</p><p>-Did you plan this?</p><p>-What do you mean by that…? While this is the outcome I wanted, I never dreamed the candidates would engage in such childish debates.</p><p>He doesn’t seem to be lying.</p><p>How could even Han Ji-hyeok have predicted that grown adults running for office would behave like that?</p><p>Honestly, the content of the debate was no different from the petty squabbles politicians have on TV every day.</p><p>And yet, the public’s disappointment was greater because the Hunter Association’s status is currently so high that people had hoped they would be different.</p><p>‘The higher the expectations, the greater the disappointment, I guess.’</p><p>But they’re still human, after all.</p><p>Or rather, many of them gained immense power before their minds could mature, leaving their emotional growth stunted—arrogant and filled with a sense of superiority.</p><p>—If I may be so bold, have you considered the possibility of me withdrawing my candidacy for vice president?</p><p>Han Ji-hyeok answered my words, thrown out like a final gambit, with a smile.</p><p>—That would be most welcome. After this debate, there’s growing support for the idea that the vice president should be appointed by the president’s authority rather than elected. It’s strange, isn’t it… the president is chosen without a vote, yet the vice president is elected.</p><p>—Even if that happens, I can simply refuse.</p><p>Han Ji-hyeok replied in a serious tone.</p><p>—Seong-hyeon, let me tell you what I think. If you reject the vice presidency, you’ll become even more famous than if you had accepted it. With hundreds of articles already pouring out about a candidate who didn’t even show up to the debate, imagine what would happen if you refused the position.</p><p>—···.</p><p>There’s no way out.</p><p>I’m completely trapped.</p><p>—There’s still the debate left, so another candidate could gain support. Don’t worry too much and just wait. Since you’re resting anyway, rest well.</p><p>—Yes, I understand.</p><p>This is a war without violence.</p><p>A war between Han Ji-hyeok, who wants to place me in the vice presidency, and me, who is desperate to escape this swamp.</p><p>As if mocking my efforts to break free, the more I struggle, the tighter the swamp clings to my ankles, dragging me deeper.</p><p>But I still have one last move.</p><p>I stepped out into the living room and approached Echo’s door, then spoke.</p><p>“Your Majesty, may this humble Daoist dare to enter?”</p><p>“Enter.”</p><p><em>Squeak</em></p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291573" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“What is it?”</p><p>“I have something urgent to discuss with you.”</p><p>Echo closed his book, looked at me, and said,</p><p>“Speak.”</p><p>I explained my current situation to Echo and sought his advice on how to escape it.</p><p>Though I called it advice, the gist of my request was, <em>‘Your Majesty, could you please go speak to Han Ji-hyeok on my behalf?’</em></p><p>No matter how skilled Han Ji-hyeok was, if Echo gave an order, there would be no way around it. I knew this method was cowardly and hadn’t wanted to use it, but Han Ji-hyeok was flexing his power to this extent. If he did, I had no choice but to lose.</p><p>He was a man who had steadfastly held onto the president’s seat in an association teeming with political maneuvering. There was no way I could compete with him in political games.</p><p>Even I thought it was a little cowardly, which was why I hadn’t wanted to resort to it.</p><p>But Echo, as if mocking my expectations, replied with a look of utter confusion.</p><p>“Then just accept the position.”</p><p>“Huh? Yet you, who possess the weapon of my old friend—a weapon he sacrificed for the sake of the weak—only think of yourself. Truly lamentable.”</p><p>“I apologize. My thinking was shallow.”</p><p>I bowed my head to Echo and left the room.</p><p>Of course, hearing Echo’s scolding didn’t change my mind or make me realize anything.</p><p>It just made me feel like the sky was falling when I realized my trump card was actually useless.</p><p>‘Yeah, as if there’s not a single bastard among the nine candidates.’</p><p>Now the only option left to me was the “prayer meta.”</p><p>Praying every day for a candidate to emerge who could flip the negative public opinion and regain the people’s support… That was my last hope.</p><p>***</p><p>That evening, after getting an earful from Echo, I received an order to go to the palace.</p><p>When I asked why Echo and Nerus weren’t coming, they said it was to deliver side dishes since the court officials had run out.</p><p>‘Now I’m just a delivery guy.’</p><p>The next morning, I loaded the car with various gourmet foods prepared by the Association and Seong Yu-na’s side dishes, then headed to the palace alone.</p><p>Ironically, driving alone on the highway put me at ease.</p><p>After spending the night having Yu-na give me a blowjob while organizing my thoughts, I concluded there was nothing I could do.</p><p>Even if I became vice president of the Association, I had no intention of working hard. </p><p>“Please come inside me, Master.”</p><p>“Mhm.”</p><p>***</p><p>A month had passed.</p><p>Yu-na’s beauty remained unchanged, though her belly had started to show a slight swell. Thanks to Yuria’s magic, Yu-na wasn’t experiencing any physical discomfort, which was a relief.</p><p>Yuria seemed to like it here too—she spent her days happily learning to cook from Yu-na or playing with Ji-hyeon.</p><p>Since that day, I’d been keeping up with the debates every day. It had been decided that the vice president of the Hunter Association would be elected by national vote, and the election would begin next month.</p><p>Out of the nine candidates besides me, five had withdrawn their candidacies.</p><p>The remaining four were locked in fierce competition, but the general landscape had more or less settled.</p><p>『Poll results: Yoon Seong-hyeon 38.7%, Lee Eun-ho 36.9%—a close race.』</p><p>Surprisingly, my approval rating had exceeded 50% in the initial polls, but after consistently skipping debates, refusing all media interviews, and maintaining complete silence, my support had dropped by over 10%.</p><p>The other candidates were confirmed as mere also-rans, and the election had boiled down to a two-horse race between me and Lee Eun-ho, the chief of the Security Bureau.</p><p>Lee Eun-ho had started as the weakest candidate, but while the others had torn each other down and self-destructed, he had stayed relatively quiet, which earned him support.</p><p>On top of that, he’d publicly pledged to split the Intelligence and Investigation Bureau back into separate agencies and reclaim various authorities, which had been met with enthusiastic approval.</p><p>‘Go for it, Lee Eun-ho!
